title: Momentum checkpoint — 1:1 prep (Rohit Banerjee) Feb 12 2027
agenda: Career checkpoint: stretch goals and promotion plan (10m)
Project sync: KV-cache rollout timeline, perf regressions (10m)
Admin: OOO coverage and oncall swaps (5m)
talking_points: PR throughput dipped last sprint — investigate root cause vs infra changes
Encourage pairing on the quantization test harness — faster onboarding for interns
Discuss time allocation: 50% code, 25% design + docs, 25% mentoring? get their preference
Promotion calibration: list of impact examples and timeline to present to L&D
Oncall burnout note — consider rotating lighter for next two sprints
metrics_snapshot: PR cycle time (median): 32h — up from 24h two sprints ago

content:
Context: X is mid-senior engineer on serving-runtime, owns parts of KV cache and quantization test harness. Last 3 weeks felt noisy: infra changes + a couple flaky perf regressions. Goal for this 1:1 is to be tactical (clear blockers) but also have a short career check-in — they asked about timeline for senior+ impact examples.

Notes to self (keep informal):
- Start positive: mention the data ingestion patch they shipped (reduces tail latency on small batches).
- Ask: where are they blocked on the KV cache rollout? (dispatch queues, gating metrics, test flakiness)
- Probe: how comfortable are they with owning cross-team rollout comms? offer to co-write the rollout doc.
- Coaching: encourage them to pick 1 mentorship focus for the quarter (intern onboarding vs doc improvements).
- Risk: PR queue backlog seems to be the biggest morale drag — see if we can carve out 0.5 day for them to clear reviews.

Open questions to bring up:
- Do they have a preferred evidence set for promotion packet? (examples, metrics, peer notes)
- Are there blocker dependencies on infra/mesh team that need leadership escalation?
- Would a short dedicated pairing session with SRE reduce flakiness faster than isolated debugging?

Quick script for the meeting: 
1) 30s small win (call out ingestion patch + doc updates)
2) 5m deep-dive on the KV-cache rollout: current gating criteria, tests failing, owners of failing suites
3) 8m career checkpoint — what signals they want included, agree on 3 artifacts to collect
4) 5m scheduling: pairing + review-clearing time this sprint
5) 30s recap + agree on 3 next actions and owners

Tone: direct, supportive, data-driven. Use examples and offer help (I will unblock or escalate).
action_items: Set up 90min pairing session with SRE on KV-cache tests — owner: Rohit — due: 2027-02-18
Book 0.5 day focus block for report to clear PR backlog this sprint — owner: Rohit — due: 2027-02-15
Draft promotion evidence list (3 artifacts + 2 peer notes) — owner: report — due: 2027-02-26
I will write a short rollout comms draft for KV-cache and share for review — owner: Rohit — due: 2027-02-16
If flakiness persists after pairing, escalate to infra lead (cc: Sara Liu) — owner: Rohit — due: 2027-02-22
follow_up_notes: After meeting: agreed to pairing next Wed; they asked for concrete examples for promotion packet (will collect: 1) ingestion patch PR, 2) perf investigation notes, 3) mentoring ledger). I promised to block calendar for review time and start the rollout comms doc. They seemed relieved about pairing with SRE; next check-in in two weeks to verify flakiness improvements.
